observations: Silver chest freezer shown with the lid open.
The brand 'AEON' is printed on the top left of the front panel and on a central sticker in photo 0.
A single white wire basket is visible inside the freezer compartment.
A control dial and two indicator lights are located at the bottom right corner of the front panel.
The background shows AEON branded boxes, one clearly marked 'FRAE200'.
The unit is placed on a tiled or paved outdoor/warehouse floor.

claims.evidence: The AEON brand name is clearly visible on the unit in photo 0.
There is no visible capacity label on the unit; the box in the background mentions 'FRAE200', which often denotes a 200L model.
The exterior finish of the freezer in photo 0 is silver.
Warranty claims require physical documentation which cannot be verified remotely.

risks.proof: A video of the freezer powered on showing frost formation on the internal walls or a thermometer reading.
A clear photo of the manufacturer's rating plate, usually found on the back or side of the appliance.

risks.risk: Damaged or poorly sealing lid gasket
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rubber seal around the entire lid.

proof_requests: Photo of the technical rating plate on the back or side of the freezer to confirm model and capacity.
Video of the freezer plugged in and cooling.
Photo of the warranty card or original purchase receipt.
response.reason: The capacity is unverified and there is a contradiction between the seller's text (150L) and the model number visible on the box in the background (FRAE200). A photo of the rating plate on the unit itself is required to confirm the specifications for pricing.
